text:
Claire Wu: Quick docs bug: the API ref examples for the /v1/files upload and SSE streaming show the Content-Type header as `application/json; charset=utf-8`. Our edge proxy normalizes headers and in some downstream setups the charset causes a mismatch with the SSE proxy which rejects the request (415).

Devon Hart: Oof. Isn't application/json; charset=utf-8 technically allowed?

Claire Wu: Yes, but our SSE endpoint expects `Content-Type: text/event-stream` for streaming responses and our upload example should use `Content-Type: multipart/form-data` or `application/json` (without charset) depending on the sample. The mixed examples have both mistakes. Specifically: the curl SSE example sends `-H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8'` and then uses `--no-buffer` to stream; that's wrong.

Ibrahim Khan: Can you paste the problematic curl?

Claire Wu: Sure:
```
curl -N -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"stream me"}'
```
Should be:
```
curl -N -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate/stream' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Accept: text/event-stream' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-small","prompt":"stream me"}'
```
And for file upload example use multipart form header or remove charset.

Devon Hart: Makes sense. I'll open a docs PR to: 1) fix curl/node/python SSE examples to use Accept: text/event-stream and Content-Type: application/json (no charset) 2) fix file upload examples to use multipart/form-data with boundary sample 3) add a one-line param note under Streaming: "Use Accept: text/event-stream and avoid charset on Content-Type for streaming requests." 4) add a docs CI header check that verifies SSE examples include Accept: text/event-stream.

Ibrahim Khan: Strong +1. Also add a short migration note: "If you relied on charset in examples, remove it to avoid proxy mismatches."

devs-bot: PR created by devon-hart: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1523 title: "docs(stream): fix content-type/accept headers in SSE and upload examples"

Devon Hart: Updated snippets, added CI check, and ran a quick staging smoke: curl SSE now connects and emits events. Left Ruby snippet comment to ensure SDK clients set Accept too.

ci-bot: docs CI example-header-check passed on PR #1523

Claire Wu: Reviewing now. Tiny copy nit: change "remove it" to "omit it" in the migration line and show the exact bad header in monospace.

Ibrahim Khan: LGTM from API behavior side. We should avoid changing runtime to accept variants; prefer docs + telemetry to find callers sending charset. Filed ENG-1239 to track telemetry.
